Do you think we only talk with words? No, we also use body language and gestures （手势）! Some gestures are common. This means that people from any culture can understand them. For example, pointing at something means "that one" or "that person" . This may not always be polite, but everyone can understand it.

Another easy gesture is "come here" . But people do it differently in different places. In America, people hold out their hand with the palm （手掌） up and move their finger back and forth （往外） . But in China, don't do that! They will be angry because people do it to ask animals to come over. They call people with their palm down.

Even the same gesture can mean different things in different places. In America, when people make a "V" shape with two fingers, it means "winning" . But in England, if you show the back of your hand when making a "V" , it's not nice! People might get angry.

And shaking your head can mean different things too. In many countries, if you shake your head from side to side, it means "no" . But in Saudi Arabia （沙特阿拉伯）, this means "yes" .

Isn't that interesting?

Have you heard of “AI self-study rooms”? It is a new business model in education, which has recently appeared in China. It is getting more and more attention, but people hold different opinions about it.

AI self-study rooms bring together AI learning tools, study monitors (监控) and a good learning environment. Students take online classes and do exercises with learning machines. At the same time, monitors help keep order. They also use AI to find students’ weak points and make personalized study plans for them.

A parent told Global Times that AI learning machines are more interactive than common online courses. They can analyze students’ learning and give them proper and challenging questions to reach their learning goals. “Now, students in the countryside can do virtual (虚拟的) biology experiments through AI self-study rooms. This was impossible before because of limited local resources,” said a teacher from Qinghai.

Some people praise AI self-study rooms for their advantages, but others think they are just for show. Some students say some AI learning machines are not smart enough. They cannot teach students in different ways and only give mechanical practice. Their updates are slow, and their fixed question banks often have mistakes, which may mislead students.

As for the price, it costs 200 yuan per hour on weekends and it is 20% off on weekdays. “We can’t afford this service. We have to think carefully about whether the price is worth the learning effect,” a parent from Jiangsu told Global Times.

      4      Students need to learn a lesson from mistakes so that they won’t make them next time
      5      Some students seem to be able to recite the English texts in groups. But if they were asked to do it alone, they can’t.		A. The old emperor liked group music. A man knew this and joined the musical team. But the new emperor enjoyed the music played by every single musician. The man without any musical ability was afraid and ran away.
B. Several men were drawing snakes on the floor. One man was the first to finish a snake, but he didn’t win because he added feet to his snake.
C. One day, a rabbit knocked itself into a tree and fell dead. A farmer nearby enjoyed the rabbit for dinner and waited for more at the same place every day. However, no rabbits came and his fields went worse.
D. A man wanted to steal a big bell next door. However, he had to make a lot of noise, so he covered his ears with pieces of cloth, thinking that if he couldn’t hear the noise, others couldn’t hear the noise
E. A sheep keeper found that a sheep was gone and he discovered there was a hole in the sheep fold (羊圈). So he fixed it right away. As a result, the rest of the sheep were safe.
F. A hard-working young man was so poor that he had to make a small hole in the wall to get light from next door at night. He read a lot of books and became an important officer for the emperor.
analysis:
【导语】本文左栏是五个学生在学习英语时遇到的问题，右栏是六则寓意对应的成语故事，需为每个学生的问题匹配与之相符的成语寓意。

【详解】1．因为和so不能连用，但有些学生常在含有because的句子中加so，B项“Several men were drawing snakes on the floor. One man was the first to finish a snake, but he didn’t win because he added feet to his snake.” 比喻多此一举、弄巧成拙，与学生画蛇添足式地错误添加“so”的行为相符。

2．有些学生可能靠运气得到正确答案，但如果只依赖运气，失败可能随之而来，C项“One day, a rabbit knocked itself into a tree and fell dead. A farmer nearby…waited for more at the same place every day. However, no rabbits came and his fields went worse.” 比喻守株待兔，依赖偶然运气而非持续努力，与靠运气学习终将失败的寓意一致。

3．有些学生假装懂语法规则，实际上并不懂，D项“A man wanted to steal a big bell next door…he covered his ears with pieces of cloth, thinking that if he couldn’t hear the noise, others couldn’t hear it.” 比喻掩耳盗铃，自欺欺人，与学生假装懂规则实则不懂的行为对应。

4．学生需要从错误中吸取教训，以免下次再犯，E项“A sheep keeper found that a sheep was gone and he discovered there was a hole in the sheep fold. So he fixed it right away. As a result, the rest of the sheep were safe.” 比喻亡羊补牢，为时未晚，与学生从错误中吸取教训的道理相符。

5．有些学生能分组背诵英语课文，但单独背诵时就不会了，A项“The old emperor liked group music. A man knew this and joined the musical team. But the new emperor enjoyed the music played by every single musician. The man without any musical ability was afraid and ran away.” 比喻滥竽充数，在集体中混迹但单独无法胜任，与学生单独背诵时露怯的情况一致。

Winter Olympics: A Celebration of Sports

The Winter Olympics are a major international event that takes place every four years. Athletes from around the world compete in various winter sports. Some of the most popular events include figure skating, speed skating, ski jumping, and ice hockey.

Figure skating is known for its grace and beauty. Athletes perform jumps, spins, and dance moves on ice. It requires strength, balance, and artistry. Speed skating is very fast and exciting. Athletes race on ice, reaching speeds of over 50 kilometres per hour. Ski jumping is one of the most thrilling events. Athletes jump from a high ramp and fly through the air before landing.

Many people watch the Winter Olympics on television. They cheer for their favourite athletes and countries. The opening ceremony is always a spectacular show of culture and creativity. It features music, dancing, and fireworks.

The Yangko dance (秧歌)

The Yangko dance, also named twisting Yangko dance, is a traditional folk dance in China. It is often performed in the northern provinces.

The Yangko dance comes from labor activities. To show different kinds of Yangko dances, the name of the place or the feature of the dance is often added ahead. For example, Shanbei Yangko dance is popular in Shaanxi, and the Guzi Yangko dance is accompanied by the sound of drums.

During the dance, people usually wear bright and colorful costumes, hold umbrellas or handkerchiefs, and dance to the music of gongs, drums and suonas.

The Yangko dance is not only a performing art, but also a self-amusement activity. People will organize Yangko dance competitions and performances whenever there is a great festival. Because of its cheerful scene, rich body language and vivid performing style, it is very popular among men and women, old and young.

Before the Spring Festival, people are very busy. They clean their houses to sweep away bad luck. They buy new clothes, food and flowers. Families get together from different places. They make dumplings together. Dumplings are a traditional food for the Spring Festival.

【导语】本文主要介绍了一款由桂林品牌制作的虎头包走红网络的故事，探讨了其背后的传统刺绣文化、制作工艺以及该品牌保护和发展传统技艺的努力。

【详解】1．句意：最近，埃隆·马斯克的儿子带着一个由桂林品牌Yastee制作的虎头包出现在北京人民大会堂。此处泛指“一个虎头包”，且“tiger”发音以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词a。

2．句意：这款可爱的文化手提包迅速在国内外网络上走红，其相关款式已完全售罄。complete“完全的”，此处修饰动词短语sold out，用其副词形式completely“完全地”。

3．句意：这款包的灵感来源于中国西北传统的虎头帽和虎头鞋。此处修饰名词inspiration，用it“它”的形容词性物主代词its“它的”。

4．句意：当地绣娘手工完成单件作品大约需要一周时间。finish“完成”，动词，句子的谓语动词是takes，此处要用动名词finishing或动词不定式to finish作主语，句子首字母需大写。
